name: Introduction to Computer Science
description: Foundational concepts of computing, algorithms, and problem solving.

name: Data Structures
description: Arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, and algorithm complexity.

name: Algorithms
description: Sorting, searching, dynamic programming, graph algorithms.

name: Operating Systems
description: Processes, threads, memory management, file systems, and scheduling.

name: Computer Networks
description: TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, routing protocols, and network security.

name: Database Systems
description: Relational model, SQL, transactions, indexing, and query optimization.

name: Web Development
description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, REST APIs, and deployment.

name: Machine Learning
description: Supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks, model evaluation.

name: Compilers
description: Lexing, parsing, semantic analysis, code generation, and optimization.

name: Distributed Systems
description: Consensus, fault tolerance, CAP theorem, MapReduce, and microservices.

name: Computer Graphics
description: Rasterization, ray tracing, shaders, transformations, and OpenGL.

name: Cybersecurity
description: Cryptography, network security, vulnerability analysis, and ethical hacking.

name: Discrete Mathematics
description: Logic, sets, relations, graphs, combinatorics, and number theory.

name: Linear Algebra
description: Vectors, matrices, eigenvalues, linear transformations, and applications.

name: Probability & Statistics
description: Random variables, distributions, hypothesis testing, Bayesian inference.

name: Human-Computer Interaction
description: User research, design principles, prototyping, and usability testing.

name: Software Engineering
description: Agile, design patterns, testing, CI/CD, and large-scale project management.

name: Natural Language Processing
description: Tokenization, transformers, LLMs, sentiment analysis, and text generation.

name: Capstone Project
description: Semester-long team project applying CS fundamentals to a real-world problem.

name: Independent Study: AI Ethics
description: Fairness, accountability, transparency, and societal impact of AI systems.
